title: A Primer of the Brass Fist
summary: Teaches any untrained beginner the first straight blows and covers of a fist fitted with a brass knuckle-duster.

title: Drill-Book of the Ring Grip
summary: Drills students in seating the fingers through the metal rings and striking with a locked wrist and body strength alone.

title: Handbook of the Close Guard in Brass
summary: A short handbook of the covering stances and quick counters of a brass-fisted fighter standing inside arm's reach.

title: Workbook of the Hooked Knuckle
summary: A workbook of looping hooks and short cross blows swung with the weight of a metal-wrapped fist and no qi.

title: Plain Treatise on Alley Boxing with Rings
summary: A plain treatise on cramped-space blows and shoves with a knuckle-duster for fighters whose bones are hardened by long labour.

title: Qi-Backed Knuckle Basics
summary: Shows students who have circulated their own qi how to thread a little of it behind a brass-fisted blow.

title: Handbook of the Boss and Bar
summary: A handbook of the raised boss and palm bar of the duster and the plain strikes using each with qi.

title: Manual of the Breathing Fist
summary: Joins each breath to a blow so a new cultivator learns to pace a brass-fisted exchange with minimal qi.

title: Canon of the Short Punch
summary: A canon of short punches thrown from a tight elbow that let a student with qi break guards in a crowded fight.

title: Circuit Primer of the Fist Ring
summary: A primer that runs a thread of qi round the arm to the ring of the fist for students finishing the Senior realm.
